records.question_pt: Quantos municipios existem e quantas UFs validas aparecem na dimensao territorial?
records.generated_sql:
WITH valid_uf(sg_uf) AS (
    VALUES ('AC'), ('AL'), ('AP'), ('AM'), ('BA'), ('CE'), ('DF'), ('ES'), ('GO'), ('MA'), ('MT'), ('MS'), ('MG'), ('PA'), ('PB'), ('PR'), ('PE'), ('PI'), ('RJ'), ('RN'), ('RS'), ('RO'), ('RR'), ('SC'), ('SP'), ('SE'), ('TO')
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_municipios,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.SG_UF) FILTER (WHERE v.sg_uf IS NOT NULL) AS total_ufs_validas,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.SG_UF) FILTER (WHERE v.sg_uf IS NULL) AS total_codigos_sg_uf_invalidos
FROM municipios m
LEFT JOIN valid_uf v
    ON m.SG_UF = v.sg_uf
